submitted_derivation.retention: Exact original bytes, including incorrect statements and examples; not an accepted theorem source.

corrections: Use pair-indexed hyperedges E_u on instruments; D_i are subsets of unresolved pairs.
q is constant on augmented-report fibers. Coarsening adds unresolved pairs and cannot lower the optimum.
Only feasible instances have a finite attained optimum; infeasibility requires an indistinguishable conflicting pair.
Cover witnesses give upper bounds. Complete subset exhaustion and Bellman tables replace incomplete branch-and-bound certificates.
The disjoint-support packing bound is LP-dual feasible and dominated by the LP bound. Withdraw false star examples and incorrect falsifier quantifiers.
Adaptive overall price is the maximum over initial p-fibers. On a nonconstant-q fiber J*=J. Optimal-child replacement exists, but every optimal tree need not have optimal slack branches.
Retain printed A=(0,1,0,1,0,0,1,1) as infeasible. Corrected A=(0,0,0,0,1,1,1,1) has independently checked fixed/adaptive prices 7/4.
The miniature has unresolved pairs {1,2} and {2,3}; instruments cover the latter. The former witnesses infeasibility.
Approximate decoding requires a supplied decoder and error guarantee; pair diameter is only a necessary condition.

verification_scope.implementation: Standalone paper reference with at most 10 states, 12 instruments and 256-bit positive exact rational input prices.
verification_scope.certificate_scope: Every fixed subset and every adaptive candidate subset is replayed from submitted tables against bound task data; no failed witness is replaced by a fresh solve.
verification_scope.efficiency: Exponential finite exhaustion; no polynomial-time or paid-model-efficiency claim.
